claims.text: Read one page, or refuse with a reason. Bounded; never follows a symlink.
claims.why: Returns (None, reason) for errors; checks size bound; does not follow symlinks (uses path.stat()).
MAX_PAGE_BYTES is defined outside this chunk.

claims.text: Every page in a vault, sorted by rel. Refusals are RETURNED, not skipped — 'we could not read four pages' and 'there are no pages' must not look alike.
claims.why: Returns both pages and refused list; sorted by rglob which yields sorted paths; empty vault returns empty lists.
MAX_PAGES is defined outside this chunk.

claims.text: Where a project vault lives. One place, so a page's address is stable.
The vaults visible from a project, project first.
claims.why: Appends project vault first, then global if provided.

claims.text: The global vault is OPT-IN via an explicit argument rather than a default home-directory path: it lives outside the repo, and everything outside the repo root breaks assumptions the index, the write-confinement rules and the egress lane all make. Until those are answered it must be a deliberate act.

claims.text: Nested tree from page paths. Deterministic: every level sorted by name.
claims.why: Sorts pages by rel, and sorts dirs keys in norm function.
